video_title: Charles Oakley stepped to JR Rider IMMEDIATELY 💀

quotes.speaker: JR Rider
quotes.summary_phrase: JR Rider recalls Charles Oakley's blunt advice during a Knicks game

text_blocks.speaker: JR Rider
text_blocks.text: I remember playing against the Knicks where they had Mason, Oakley, Ewing. I'm going to the rack, I dunked on somebody and they told me, yeah, next time you go in the rack, you're going to end up on your back. So I went right to the rack and they knocked me down. And I just remember saying, 'Next motherf***er foul me, it's on in this motherf***er.' And Oakley said, 'Shut the f*** up and shoot your motherf***ing free throws.'

text_blocks.speaker: JR Rider
text_blocks.text: Grown ass men with hair on they chest, so you better pick your battles!

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: My question, did you shut the f*** up and shoot your free throws or you keep talking?
